subject: Unforeseen field condition: unforeseen underground obstruction at Placement Zone 2

messages.text: We found the unforeseen underground obstruction at Placement Zone 2; see General Conditions Article 3 for the assumed condition. Our proposal is to shift the layout locally and hold everything else per plan -- let us know if that works or if you need to review first. This is becoming a priority as work proceeds nearby. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. This could affect the overall schedule. A response next week would still let us stay on track.
We'll need photos and measurements of the unforeseen underground obstruction at Placement Zone 2 before we can evaluate the workaround. There will be a cost impact to address this condition.

Attached photos show that the condition at Placement Zone 2 is more extensive than first reported; our workaround proposal still holds otherwise. A response next week would still let us stay on track.
